Формула (LaTeX)
Формула (LaTeX) is the title or name of a mathematical equation.<SEP>A mathematical formula represented in LaTeX format.<SEP>A mathematical formula in LaTeX format.<SEP>A mathematical formula represented in LaTeX notation.

formula_0
Formula_0 represents a specific mathematical formula.

x
x is an unknown variable in the quadratic equation.<SEP>The variable x represents the solution to the quadratic equation.

b
b is an unknown coefficient in the quadratic equation.<SEP>b is one of the coefficients in a quadratic equation, used for calculating the discriminant.<SEP>The variable b is one of the coefficients in the quadratic equation.<SEP>The variable 'b' represents a numerical value in the equation.

c
c is another unknown coefficient in the quadratic equation.<SEP>c is yet another coefficient in a quadratic equation, used alongside b and a to calculate the discriminant.

x^2 + bx + c = 0
The quadratic equation x^2 + bx + c = 0 is represented by formula_0.

x^2
x is squared in the equation.

x = 0
The statement x equals 0 is asserted for formula_0.

D
D represents the discriminant in a quadratic equation.<SEP>The variable D represents the discriminant, which determines the nature of the roots of a quadratic equation.

a
a is another coefficient in a quadratic equation, used alongside b and c to calculate the discriminant.<SEP>The variable a is another coefficient in the quadratic equation and part of the denominator.<SEP>The variable 'a' represents a value that equals 1 according to the assertion.

formula_1
Formula_1 represents a specific mathematical formula.

b^2
b is raised to the power of 2 before being subtracted from D.

4ac
4 times a times c is subtracted from D.

formula_3
A document identifier for the formula "b = 12".

с
с represents a data point in the context of the given mathematical expression.

a = 1
The formula "formula_5" refers to and is asserted by the equation a = 1.
